short_bio: Actor and narrator, Oscar winner for Million Dollar Baby and star of The Shawshank Redemption.
biography:
Morgan Freeman was born in Memphis, Tennessee, and served in the United States Air Force before turning to acting. Children’s television gave him early exposure: he played Easy Reader on The Electric Company in the 1970s.

Film roles in Street Smart, Driving Miss Daisy and Glory brought Oscar nominations, and The Shawshank Redemption (1994) followed. He won Best Supporting Actor for Million Dollar Baby (2004) and played Nelson Mandela in Invictus (2009).

His voice is one of the most recognisable in cinema; he narrated March of the Penguins and many documentaries. He received the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2011.
